verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes a documented HTTP interface with a published OpenAPI spec (clickhouse-probe-3), an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to call it via JSON-RPC (clickhouse-docs-5, clickhouse-docs-6, clickhouse-probe-4, clickhouse-probe-rt-3), and a CLI/clickhouse-local for scriptable SQL access (clickhouse-probe-rt-1, clickhouse-probe-rt-2), all confirmed working keylessly in hands-on runtime probes. missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration of the OpenAPI/HTTP API's completeness or stability, and no evidence of rate-limits/versioning guarantees for programmatic/agentic use at scale.
